### Do Not Be Afraid
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/do-not-be-afraid
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:15
Points:
- Jehoshaphat faced impossible odds when a coalition of invading armies marched toward Jerusalem.
- Instead of leaning on human alliances, the king led the nation in prayer, openly admitting total helplessness.
- God answered through Jahaziel with the assurance that the battle belonged to Him, not Judah.
- God allows severe crises in our lives to expose our self-reliance and deepen our trust in Him.
- True freedom comes from the settled confidence that God will deliver and provide in every distress.

### The God Who Fights Our Battles
Author: Sarah Freymuth
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-12-2003.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:15
Points:
- Exhausting hardships and emotional pain often push believers to the absolute end of their strength.
- When trapped by overwhelming odds, our first response should be turning completely to God in prayer.
- God answers our weakness with authority and comfort, reminding us the battle is His.
- Believers are instructed not to run from hardship, but to stand firm and face it in faith.
- Offering praise and thanksgiving before deliverance arrives honors God's faithful character.
